tournament.name: Kards Open XV - Qualifier B
tournament.description:
The KARDS Open saga continues with the last Open of 2022 - Kards Open 15! In this open, you will compete in three levels of increased challenge - Two chances to qualify with Swiss, A top 16 cut and a final 4 live on stream.

STAGE ONE - Starting Saturday, February 4th with the swiss qualifiers, you will compete in a best of 3 free-for-all deck format. This means you can bring any deck you want and play it as many times as you'd like. No deck submissions and no deck restrictions! If you make the top 8 in this stage, you will advance to stage two.

The Last Chance Qualifier will be Saturday, March 4th. This swiss bracket is open to any player who has not already made the top 8 cuts from Qualifier A.

STAGE TWO - If you finish in the Top 8 from either stage weekend, you will be qualified for the next stage - Saturday, March 18th to compete in the single elimination best of 5 conquest.  In the top 16, participants play a Single Elimination bracket with closed deck lists in a best of 5 series. However, each win must be with a deck from a different main nation.

STAGE THREE - In the top 4, players submit 4 decks from different main nations and continue to play a Single Elimination bracket, in a best of 5 series, on Sunday March 19th. This final part of the Open is played with open deck lists.


PRIZE POOL

1st: $600 USD
2nd: $450 USD
3rd: $250 USD
4th: $200 USD
5th-8th: 500 Diamonds and 2000 Gold
9th-16th: 200 Diamonds and 1000 Gold
17th-32nd: 1000 Gold

FORMAT & SCHEDULE

Swiss Qualifiers

  • Compete in one or both qualifier swiss bracket weekends.

  • Top 8 from each weekend bracket moves on to Top - Cuts weekend

  • Closed deck lists with no deck restrictions! Play whatever you want, whenever you want!

  • Best of Three matchups

  • Swiss Bracket with 212 player maximum (8 swiss rounds)

  • Swiss Qualifier Bracket A February 4th @ 1300 GMT

  • Swiss Qualifier Bracket B March 4th @ 1600 GMT

Top Cuts

  • Bring four decks from four different main nations

  • Top 16 conquest format best of 5 with closed deck lists

  • Top 16 Bracket March 18th @ 1300 GMT

  • Top 4 Bracket & Live Stream March 19th @ 1300 GMT

Kards Open Full Rules and Regulations: https://support.kards.com/hc/en-us/articles/8712237212697-KARDS-Tournament-Official-Rules

  • The Kards Esports Discord will be the main hub of communication with the tournament admins. This is the required method for contacting an admin if you have questions or a match dispute: https://discord.gg/288DQexmng

  • For Chinese players who can not access Discord, there is a Wechat group for tournament communication. Contact: 003546614978
